headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 18, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Boston Red Sox in a thrilling 4-3 victory, with Nathan Lukes leading the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and one RBI. The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought win over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Parker Messick pitching 6.0 innings and striking out 9 batters. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Michael Helman, a center fielder for the Texas Rangers, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture. Other notable injuries include Ryne Nelson (Arizona Diamondbacks), Wenceel Pérez (Detroit Tigers), Mike Trout (Los Angeles Angels), Everson Pereira (Chicago White Sox), Cole Ragans (Kansas City Royals), Spencer Strider (Atlanta Braves), and Chase DeLauter (Cleveland Guardians).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including Hunter Stratton being traded from the Atlanta Braves to the Pittsburgh Pirates, Joey Bart being traded from the Atlanta Braves to the Pittsburgh Pirates, Randy Dobnak being traded from the Seattle Mariners to the Kansas City Royals, Tyler Heineman being traded from the Toronto Blue Jays to the Los Angeles Angels, and Connor Seabold being traded from the Toronto Blue Jays to the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Nathan Lukes led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and one RBI.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought win over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Parker Messick pitching 6.0 innings and striking out 9 batters. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Rangers 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-3 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Trevor Larnach leading the offense and Joe Ryan dominating on the mound. Larnach hit 3 home runs, drove in 3 runs, and went 5 for 5 at the plate, while Ryan pitched 5 strong innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Orioles in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 3-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Bryan Woo pitching 7.0 innings, allowing 3 hits, 1 walk, and no earned runs, striking out 9 batters. Andrés Muñoz earned the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Rout Blue Jays 16-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays in a lopsided 16-2 victory, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring performance. Impact hitters for the Cubs included George Springer, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Ian Happ, Nico Hoerner, and Carson Kelly.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Helman Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture.

top_news.title: **Stratton Swapped: Pirates Acquire RHP Hunter Stratton**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Hunter Stratton in a trade with the Atlanta Braves. Stratton joins the Pirates in exchange for catcher Joey Bart.
